title: USF-1074 Dev Compose Provider Profile Consolidation Map
authorityBoundary: This map is a lower-authority supporting summary. It is lower authority than the compose manifests (compose/compose.yaml), the compose-service catalogue and semantic contracts, the provider-mode instances, the runtime-proof evidence, and the validators. It records provider classification and dev-compose profile consolidation only. It makes no live-provider, production, staging, or deployment claim, and asserts no runtime product readiness upgrade.
